The Fine Grained Classifier predicting 'cloak' instead of 'comic book' further confirms this misalignment. The presence of gibberish text further degrades the 'functional component' alignment.

Background textures are noisy rather than crisp halftones. These issues prevent a high artifact score, though the overall composition remains visually coherent enough to avoid a catastrophic rating.
